name: Fear Me [Jeff the Killer's Dating Sim]
source:
How unlucky do you have to be to find yourself under the gaze of a ruthless killer? 

  …Maybe you can survive if you earn his trust, but to romance him, you’ll have to stay alive first.

On what seems like a normal day at your job as a video store clerk, you meet a mysterious man who appears to take a deep interest in you.

Fear Me is a suspense and romance visual novel where you interact with the infamous creepypasta character Jeff the Killer.
[From the Itch.io page]
